title: Middle Data Analyst
description: Boosters — це українська продуктова компанія. Ми створюємо глобальні продукти в сферах EdTech, Productivity та Wellness, які несуть цінність для 55 мільйонів людей . Для нас важливо будувати продукти з довготривалим впливом — системні, масштабні та здатні залишатися актуальними десятиліттями. Можливо, ти вже бачила(ив) наші спін-оффи — Avrora та Promova. Зараз ми шукаємо Data Analyst в наш флагманський продукт JustDone — AI асистент для академічної аудиторії , який допомагає краще працювати з науковими роботами, навчатись і проводити глибинні дослідження. Ми віримо, що AI може суттєво змінити те, як люди навчаються та працюють з інформацією. Не через cheating, а через якісніший і глибший рісьорч, швидшу роботу з великими обсягами інформації та автоматизацію формальних і рутинних задач. Так у студентів і дослідників залишається більше часу на те, що справді має значення — мислення, навчання та власні ідеї. Основна мета цієї ролі — перетворювати дані на інсайти та дієві рішення, які допомагають JustDone зростати. Сьогодні JustDone це 3+ млн преміум користувачів; #1 позиція в США в ніші AI Writing Assistants; 90%+ одиниць контенту, створених користувачами, знаходять реальне застосування; понад 3 млн одиниць контенту, який генерується користувачами щомісяця; власні AI та NLP рішення: AI Detector, Text Humanization Engines, AI Research Assistant. Твоє майбутнє середовище Наша головна перевага — це люди. Ми працюємо з тими, хто щодня прагне до самовдосконалення та задає високу планку гри. Ти приєднаєшся до команди аналітики, яка допомагає бізнесу краще розуміти, що відбувається з продуктом, знаходити точки зростання та приймати сильніші рішення на основі даних, де щодня взаємодіятимеш з Танею Є., Танею М. та Владом. Лідер напрямку — Сергій, BI & Analytics Lead. У роботі з Сергієм багато простору для самостійності: він не буде розкладати кожну задачу на кроки, натомість дасть можливість самому розібратися, поставити правильні питання та знайти найкраще рішення. Водночас Сергій завжди готовий підключитися там, де це справді потрібно. У команді багато уваги приділяють тому, щоб аналітика не зводилася лише до цифр і звітів. Важливо розуміти, що саме відбулося, чому це сталося та як на це можна вплинути. Команда активно використовує AI та автоматизацію, щоб зменшувати кількість рутинних задач і давати аналітикам більше часу на складніші дослідження та пошук інсайтів. Саме в цій ролі ти отримаєш Можливість впливати на розвиток аналітики та продукту - не просто працювати з готовими даними, а власноруч розвивати систему та втілювати свої ідеї. Велике поле для пошуку інсайтів - працювати з масштабними масивами даних і знаходити закономірності, які можуть впливати на бізнес-рішення. Роботу на стику аналітики та AI - взаємодіяти з NLP-командою, використовувати готові AI-рішення та долучатися до розвитку цього напрямку. Твоя зона впливу Аналізувати маркетингові, продуктові та платіжні дані, знаходити точки зростання й формувати ідеї для розвитку продукту та залуче

title: Software Test Engineer
description: Position Overview: The Software Test Engineer (Mid-Level) is responsible for the overall quality of the Simr Platform, a web application that lets engineers run and manage their simulation workflows in the cloud. The platform has two main areas: the HPC side, where users run batch jobs and work in interactive sessions on HPC clusters, and the data side, where simulation results are ingested, processed, stored and made available for search, analysis and reporting through DataStudio, APIs and Jupyter notebooks. While the role covers the platform as a whole, its main focus is the data side. The engineer is expected to understand the data workflows in depth, from simulation output files to queryable tables and reports, and to own their test planning, manual and automated testing, and data validation. Working closely with backend, data and frontend engineers, the engineer catches issues early and makes sure data features are released with confidence. The ideal candidate works independently on medium-complexity tasks, is comfortable with SQL and Python, and enjoys understanding how data moves through a modern, cloud-based system. Responsibilities: Plan, design and execute test cases for the Simr Platform, with a focus on data ingestion, processing, storage and reporting features. Validate data end to end, from source files to what users see in the UI, APIs and reports, checking accuracy, completeness and consistency. Test core HPC workflows of the platform, such as batch job submission and interactive sessions, as part of regression and release testing. Use SQL and scripting to verify data and back-end behavior independently. Test REST APIs and asynchronous/background processes, including error handling, retries and permissions. Develop and maintain automated tests and integrate them into CI pipelines for regression and release testing. Conduct performance tests for data-heavy scenarios and report the results. Perform regression and release testing across different environments. Investigate issues using logs, report bugs in JIRA with clear reproduction steps, and verify fixes. Take part in requirement reviews and help define acceptance criteria. Maintain test documentation (test plans, test cases, checklists, reports) and suggest process improvements. Support junior QA engineers when needed. Skills & Qualifications: Must Have Solid knowledge of software testing methodologies, test planning and test case design. Good SQL skills for data validation. Experience testing REST APIs (e.g., Postman or similar tools). Programming experience in Python, Java or JavaScript for test automation (Python preferred). Experience with test automation and running tests in CI pipelines. Familiarity with Linux, version control (Git) and issue tracking tools (JIRA). Nice to Have Familiarity with data pipelines, databases or big data tools (e.g., Airflow, Trino, Spark). Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP) and containers (Docker, Kubernetes). title: Junior Quantitative Researcher
description: Junior Quantitative Researcher About the role Deeter Analytics is a privately held investment research and trading firm managing its own capital across public markets. After years of discretionary success, we think we have some unique ways of seeing the market, and we pair sharp human judgment with modern AI to act on them. A lot of what we trade starts as a hunch at the desk: a pattern that keeps showing up, a relationship that feels like it should hold, a setup someone wants to trust but doesn't yet. We're hiring a Junior Quantitative Researcher to turn those hunches into evidence, and evidence into signals the desk actually uses. You'll take questions from the traders, test them honestly against the data, and come back in plain language: what holds, what doesn't, how strong, since when, and where it breaks. This is not a systematic seat: your models won't trade on their own, and you won't be one factor in an anonymous alpha pool. Your work is done when a trader understands it, trusts it, and acts on it. It's an entry point into a serious seat: as your signals prove out, they get more weight in the book, and you get more scope. The role is full-time and fully remote, US-based, overlapping the desk on US market hours. What you'll own The question queue. Desk hunches in, answers out. You scope the question, run the study, and come back sometimes same-day with what the data says, at the depth the question deserves. The signal shelf. A growing library of signals and screens the desk trades around (earnings and event setups, positioning and flow extremes, regime and factor context) each with a documented edge, known failure modes, and live tracking against expectation. You retire what decays. The evidence standard. Event studies, conditioning analyses, base rates, and walk-forward checks that hold up: point-in-time data, no leakage, no survivorship, costs counted, multiple-testing restraint. A backtest here is a way to kill an idea, not to sell it. The quant read. The recurring numbers layer under the desk's picture of the market (regime, factor moves, breadth, positioning) feeding the morning picture rather than duplicating it. The research data. Clean, point-in-time datasets (prices, fundamentals, earnings calendars, options and positioning) organized so every number you've ever reported traces back to code and data. AI leverage. Use modern AI tools to test more ideas, read more literature, and write cleaner code than one person otherwise could, and verify what they give you. Who you are We hire for demonstrated judgment and how you think, not for pedigree. This is a junior seat, so we don't expect a markets résumé — the best evidence usually comes from wherever you've already done rigorous quantitative work. We look for signs that you are: Rigorous where it counts. You think in base rates, sample sizes, and conditioning; you know what autocorrelation, overlapping windows, and fat tails do to naive statistics, and you'd rather report a small hones

Ever daydreamed about sleuth-level mastery the likes of Charlotte Justice, Easy Rawlins, or Veronica Mars... or perhaps captivated by the show Mr. Robot, national news like the Log4Shell Zero-Day vulnerability and major ransomware incidents, or the topic of election security? Our Security Operations Center (SOC) Analyst internship may be for you! Let’s face it - Finding hands-on opportunities to learn about cybersecurity can be tough, and there isn’t one set path into this field. The industry needs organizations that are willing and able to train and equip the next generation of cybersecurity leaders, to secure our organizations, businesses, and nation. There is an imperative to break the mold of who is typically considered a cybersecurity professional, and it takes more than technical ability to succeed. With that in mind, we see the cybersecurity skills gap as an opportunity and are eager to be an on-ramp for those who want to learn and find a pathway into the constantly evolving, challenging world of online security. Sure, our team has plenty of people with traditional IT-related backgrounds, but we also have team members who have crossed into cybersecurity from completely unrelated fields ranging from Education to Emergency Medical Technicians. We believe that having technically competent analysts with diversity of thought, culture, and experiences not only creates a better world but also fosters a more inclusive work environment. This gives us a competitive advantage to better protect our range of clients with the ability to consider threats from more diverse perspectives. SOC analysts are the first line of defense for any of C3’s clients. Analysts have the critical responsibility to initially triage and make key decisions about how to identify, investigate, and address potentially malicious activity in a client’s network. This internship is designed to give students and aspiring cybersecurity professionals an opportunity to gain real-world experience working within a SOC, providing exposure to the technology, data, processes, and expectations that accompany a SOC analyst role. Guided coaching, paired with independently driven, hands-on activities will help you develop vital technical skills as well as soft skills. The internship offers ambitious students an opportunity to move from theoretical knowledge to practical experience. Intrigued? Awesome! Here’s what you need to know about us: Our SOC began as a homegrown Louisiana-based company, focused on establishing Louisiana as a cybersecurity center of excellence. That means being the best at what we do so that we can bring 5,000 industry jobs to the state of “Union, Justice, and Confidence”. We would love to provide this internship opportunity to a student or resident of the state. As such, this cohort is only accepting applicants who are or will be enrolled in a Computer Science or Cybersecurity focused degree program within the LSU System S

title: Head of Revenue Operations
description: At Haut.AI , we make skin measurable. Our technology, including AI Skin Analysis, SkinGPT and Skin.Chat, powers personalized, science-backed experiences online and in store. Today, more than 100 global beauty brands use our technology, including enterprise companies like Neutrogena, Beiersdorf, Ulta Beauty, Grupo Boticário and OLAY. We are looking for a Head of Revenue to own Haut.AI ’s full commercial engine: new business and customer success in one function and lead a team of six exceptional teammates. This is a player-coach role reporting directly to our CEO. What you will do: Own the revenue number. You own new business, renewals and expansion, plus the forecast and the commercial KPIs. You give leadership a clear view of where things really stand. Lead and grow the team. Hire, coach and develop three Account Executives and Account Managers. Run weekly pipeline reviews and one-on-ones that focus on growth as much as on numbers. Coach deal by deal and account by account. Join calls and demos, and give specific feedback while it is fresh. Set a clear standard for discovery, proposals, pricing and demo prep. Carry the biggest deals yourself. Lead a small set of our largest, most strategic enterprise opportunities. Personally manage our most valuable client relationships at senior level. Keep complex buying groups moving. Enterprise beauty deals involve brand and marketing, e-commerce, IT, data privacy, legal and procurement. You map the group, align it and keep it moving toward signature. Build the system the team runs on. This means playbooks and objection handling, and a clean handoff from Account Executive to Account Manager once a deal closes. It also means CS operations from onboarding to renewal and expansion, and health scores that surface risk early. Put AI to work across revenue. Find where AI cuts busywork and sharpens decisions: call prep, deal reviews, proposals, account health. Get hands-on with the tools; don’t stop at writing the plan. Stay close to clients and bring back what you learn. Sit in on onboarding and business reviews. Turn client feedback into real input for Product and Marketing, and bring pricing and packaging signals back from the market. What makes you a fit: An experienced commercial leader. You have 8+ years in B2B SaaS commercial roles, including 3+ years leading a team. Ideally you have owned both new business and account management or customer success. A player-coach. You have built and led a commercial team, and you still enjoy running a deal, reviewing the proposal and joining the call. Your team follows your example. At home with enterprise. You have closed complex enterprise deals with many stakeholders and long sales cycles. You are comfortable in the room with senior leaders, with exceptional English and real executive presence.

title: Backend Engineer (Node.js / TypeScript)
description: About Nexoya We help marketing teams unlock their growth potential with AI. Our attribution shows how advertising investments perform across channels, and our optimizations shift budgets to where they drive the bottom line. Leading European brands in e-commerce, telco, banking, insurance, energy and more rely on us. The role You build and run the Node.js/TypeScript services behind the Nexoya app: the GraphQL API, ad channel integrations and data ingestion, and new LLM- and agent-based features. You join a team of about 10 engineers across backend, ML, frontend and platform, and you own your features from design to production. How we build software AI coding agents change how software gets built, but not who is responsible for it. Decisions are made together. Important technical decisions start as an Architecture Decision Record reviewed by the team. Good arguments win, not seniority. Engineers design, agents implement. Your design is the input for our coding agents, guided by a shared rule set in our agent harness that the team evolves together. Working is not done. Code is ready when it is maintainable: readable, tested, robust on unhappy paths. Larger changes are reviewed, so at least two engineers know every change. You build it, you run it. A rotating internal support duty shows us which decisions worked. What you will do Ship backend features end to end on our Kubernetes-based Azure cloud. Evolve our GraphQL API with clear schemas and stable contracts. Build reliable ad channel integrations and data ingestion with MySQL and RabbitMQ. Build AI features such as our in-app assistant (tool calling, retrieval, structured outputs), with evaluation, monitoring and guardrails. Help evolve our agent harness and raise the bar for tests, reviews and documentation. What you bring [3+] years as a Backend Engineer with Node.js and TypeScript. Solid API design (GraphQL or REST) and MySQL experience. Experience with message brokers and running services on Docker, Kubernetes and a major cloud (Azure preferred). You enjoy discussing design trade-offs in writing and care about code others can maintain. Fluent English. Bonus: ad platform APIs (Google Ads, Meta) or attribution; AI or agent features in production (Anthropic/OpenAI APIs, MCP, RAG); LLM evaluation or observability; team use of Claude Code or similar; data pipelines; German. What we offer Direct impact on how enterprise marketers allocate their budgets. Real ownership in a team that takes engineering quality seriously. A genuine AI-first culture: experiment, automate, share. A transparent culture at eye level, with regular team events. Strategy Days twice a year where the whole team shapes company strategy (past: Helsinki, Berlin, Belgrade, Swiss Alps, Zurich).
